subject.title: Feature: notify sender on WhatsApp after pairing approval

question: Should WhatsApp pairing approval notification be implemented through an additive shared plugin SDK/gateway delivery mode, or through a narrower WhatsApp-owned notifier shape?
rationale: Current main has the user-facing `--notify` contract but no WhatsApp delivery hook; the previous fix attempt solved this by adding plugin SDK surface, which is compatibility-sensitive and needs maintainer intent before automation should pick the permanent seam.

options.title: Approve a narrow gateway-backed repair
options.body: Implement the existing `--notify` flow with the smallest shared seam needed for WhatsApp gateway delivery and require focused tests plus redacted live/gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Accept the additive SDK mode
options.body: Revive the prior `delivery: "outbound-message"`-style plugin SDK direction and document it as a supported pairing-notification contract.

options.title: Keep WhatsApp notify unsupported for now
options.body: Leave this issue open or close as not planned if maintainers do not want the proof-heavy WhatsApp delivery path at this time.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow gateway-backed repair
recommendation.body: Implement the existing `--notify` flow with the smallest shared seam needed for WhatsApp gateway delivery and require focused tests plus redacted live/gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is mainly about plugin SDK/channel contract shape and gateway-backed delivery, areas where recent history points most strongly to steipete.
